_note: Thresholds and per-source evidence fields for scripts/resolve-municipal-review-backlog.mjs. Thresholds are distances in metres and are shared by every source; per-source entries only name raw attribute fields that carry source-side textual evidence (never used as ids). Geometry type, id/name fields and taxonomy come from data/municipal-ingestion-configs.json. name_based_non_green_tokens: for sources whose PARK evidence is only the record name (no taxonomy column), a name containing one of these tokens (compounds like technology park / car park) is NOT trustworthy park evidence.
